IS : 9783 - 1981 EXPLANATORY NOTE

This standard has been issued in order to e n s u r e that s a m e terms are used by all concerned to define the components of wrist watches. The nomenclature given in the standard is based on ISO 3831-1979 'Timekeeping Instruments--Classification and Numbering System and Nomenclature of Components for Watches and C l o c k s ' excepting some modifications which have been made so as to retain some of the terms as are commonly used and understood by the watch manufacturers in this country. In order to eliminate ambiguity and confusion the terms given in ISO 3831-1979, wherever different, have been indicated in parenthesis.

21
